visual_grammar.label: 3-Pillar Photorealistic Geopolitical Documentary + 4-Mode Visual Storytelling Combination
three_pillars: Orbital satellite relief & true-color physical geological geography
100mm macro mechanical, metallurgical, and cleanroom supply-chain engineering
On-site maritime, industrial, port, and geopolitical field documentary photography
visual_grammar.anti_repetition_rule: Diverse subjects, locations, lighting, and physical textures per beat; strictly no locked tabletop desk or crimson steel clamp props across unrelated beats; allowed_text=None on raw Flow frames.

CACH_1_HERO_STAMP.role: Giant 2K kinetic typography stat/keyword hero card (156px/68px) on shocking figures and choke-point pivots

CACH_2_SPLIT_COMPARE.role: Dual-image split-screen comparison (Red #FF3B30 vs Cyan #00F5D4) on geopolitical or value-chain asymmetries

CACH_3_DOSSIER_LIST.role: Right-docked dark glassmorphic intelligence dossier panel (3 sequential checklist items) on multi-tier supply-chain breakdowns

CACH_4_CINEMATIC_PACING.role: Uncluttered 2K dynamic camera pacing (zoom_in_center, zoom_out_reveal, pan_left_to_right, pan_right_to_left + key-beat I2V motion) and xfade=fade:duration=0.18
